summary.short: Converts Provisional Measure 1.317/2025 and amends the LGPD to create the ANPD as a special-nature autarchy linked to the Ministry of Justice and Public Security. Creates a data protection regulation career and posts, and sets 17 March 2026 as the start of the ECA Digital. Takes effect on publication.
summary.long: Law 15.352/2026 converts Provisional Measure 1.317/2025 and amends the General Data Protection Law (LGPD, Law 13.709/2018). It adds definitions of 'encarregado' and 'autoridade nacional' and a new LGPD Chapter IX creating the ANPD as a special-nature autarchy linked to the Ministry of Justice and Public Security, with functional, technical, decision-making, administrative and financial autonomy. It creates a Data Protection Regulation and Inspection career in Law 10.871/2004 and transforms 797 vacant effective posts into 200 specialist posts and 18 commissioned or trust functions. Holders of the career posts are given prerogatives to order the interdiction of establishments and seize goods when exercising fiscal or police powers. The ANPD must publish a plan for adapting its regulation within 30 days of the publication of the act setting its new regimental structure. Law 15.211/2025 (ECA Digital) is amended so that it enters into force on 17 March 2026. Provisional Measure 1.319/2025 is revoked. The law takes effect on publication.

Art. 19 sets a specific entry-into-force date for the ECA Digital art. 41-A; Art. 21 sets publication as the general entry-into-force date.

thresholds.note: This amending act concerns ANPD structure, career and position creation, salary tables and transitional deadlines. Its numbers are position counts, pay values and time limits (coded as events where relevant), not cutoffs that change the legal treatment of persons, entities or services. The amended LGPD text contains no such cutoffs.
